name_en: Multivalued random dynamical systems (catalog topic label)

statement_blocker: The catalog does not select a state space, probability base and driving flow, time domain, set-valued solution map, measurability and cocycle conventions, stochastic equation or inclusion, assumptions, or a definition, construction, existence, uniqueness, attractor, invariance, compactness, or asymptotic conclusion. Selecting a familiar MRDS theorem would substitute missing mathematics.
domain_and_universes: Open: an exact source must fix a complete separable metric, Polish, Hilbert, Banach, or other state space and universes; a probability or metric dynamical base; continuous or discrete time; the set-valued codomain and nonemptiness/closedness/compactness convention; and any stochastic equation or differential-inclusion spaces.
conclusion: Open: the source names a framework for nonunique random evolution but states no truth-valued definition-equivalence, cocycle construction, measurability, perfection, existence, uniqueness, invariant-set, attractor, compactness, or asymptotic result.
candidate_scope_not_credited: a source-specified definition or characterization of a measurable multivalued cocycle
construction of an MRDS from a source-specified stochastic differential or parabolic inclusion with nonunique solutions
perfection of a crude or very crude multivalued cocycle under source-specified hypotheses
existence, uniqueness, invariance, minimality, or measurability of a global random attractor for an MRDS
upper or lower semicontinuity, compactness, closed-graph, absorption, or asymptotic-compactness results
a source-specified application to a reaction-diffusion inclusion or another stochastic PDE
degenerate_cases_to_resolve: empty values versus nonempty closed or compact values
zero time, trivial noise, one-point state or sample spaces, and deterministic specializations
continuous nonnegative time versus discrete time and invertible versus one-sided driving dynamics
perfect, crude, and very crude cocycles and whether exceptional null sets depend on one or two times
pointwise, almost-sure, completed-sigma-algebra, and invariant-full-measure scopes
nonunique solution selections, concatenation, and whether equality or inclusion is the cocycle law
bounded deterministic versus random attracting sets and pullback versus forward attraction
compact, asymptotically compact, upper semicontinuous, lower semicontinuous, or merely measurable values
empty attractors, noncompact phase spaces, explosion, and failure of global solution existence
excluded_substitutions: THM-M-1424 random dynamical systems and THM-M-1425 random attractors as silent replacements
a deterministic multivalued semiflow or differential inclusion with no random base
a single-valued random dynamical system obtained by assuming uniqueness
a finite relation or powerset-valued toy example in place of the source theorem family
a structure that assumes measurability, the cocycle law, an attractor, or the requested conclusion as fields
generic relation, set-image, measurable-space, measure-preserving, compactness, or continuity API lemmas
